children: Bitcoin rose during each of the past three weekends before reversing on Monday, analyst Killa said. According to Odaily, Killa wrote on X that markets often move in the opposite direction when weekend selling pressure increases; if Bitcoin rises toward the weekly close, Monday is worth watching, while the last time Bitcoin began falling over the weekend, it subsequently rose.

title: Analyst Killa: Bitcoin Reversed on Monday After Three Weekend Gains
